description: Returns the CPI indexation currently in force for the procedural indemnity amounts, the latest Belgian CPI (base 2004), the estimated date of the next indexation, and the monthly CPI of the last five years. A new multiplier is the CPI of the month that reaches the threshold divided by the start index 105.78, so it is at least next_indexation_minimum_multiplier; do not derive it from the current multiplier.

locale.description: Language of the card and the calculator link. Always set it to the language the user writes in (nl, fr, de or en; use "en" for any other language). Defaults to "nl".

name: get_indexation_status
title: Get indexation status
